text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to rescind the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the north side of Queen's Drive, between Jane Street and Upwood Avenue. The proposed removal is based on a request received from the Ward Councillor after missing signage was installed and area residents expressed their desire to have on-street parking for the City-wide three hour maximum as they did before the missing signage was replaced.
Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the north side of Queen's Drive, between Jane Street and Upwood Avenue.
